items.computation: Start event is the Rechnungsdatum 22.04.2026 (Wednesday). Under §187 Abs.1 BGB the day of the event is not counted, so the 10-day period starts 23.04.2026. Counting 10 days: 23,24,25,26,27,28,29,30 April (8 days) + 1,2 May (2 days) = 10 days, ending Saturday 02.05.2026. As this is a payment deadline, §193 BGB applies: since the last day is a Saturday, the deadline moves to the next working day. Sunday 03.05.2026 is not a working day either, and Monday 04.05.2026 is not a public holiday in NW (payer's Land), so the deadline moves to Monday 04.05.2026.
